summary: The airship lifts out of Liberio. Gabi and Falco are aboard. One shot from the children's deck reaches Sasha.

segments.ja: オニャンコポンの飛行船が、リベリオの煙の上へ上がります。上がる甲板に、調査兵団の生存者が次々と乗ってきます。乗ってくる中に、エレンの巨人が小さくなり、人の姿へ戻る蒸気があります。ある蒸気のあと、強襲は離脱の時間に入ります。入る時間は、勝ち祝いではありません。ではありません。町を割ったあとの、逃げの列です。列の端で、ジャンが人数を数えます。上がる煙の下で、甲板の床はまだ熱を持っています。
segments.en: Onyankopon's airship rises above Liberio's smoke. Survivors of the Survey Corps come aboard the rising deck one after another. Among those who come aboard, there is steam as Eren's Titan grows smaller and returns toward a human shape. After the steam that is there, the assault enters the time of withdrawal. The time it enters is not a victory celebration. It is not. It is the line of flight after splitting a town. At the edge of the line, Jean counts the number of people. Under the rising smoke, the deck floor is still hot.

tokens.note: A volunteer engineer. He keeps the airship and the machines running for the island.

segments.en: After coming up on deck, Sasha laughs once. The reason she laughs is that she is hungry, and someone had food. She shares the bite that was had with Connie. The sound of sharing rings small on the airship's iron floor. Jean watches the laugh that rings without getting angry. The reason he watches is that this laugh is proof of surviving today. The proof does not continue long. It does not continue. Children's footsteps are approaching from another compartment.

segments.en: Gabi and Falco have entered the ship, mixed into the confusion of the withdrawal. Gabi, who has entered, is still hiding the gun she picked up. The purpose of hiding it is to shoot even one soldier of the island. She chooses the opponent to shoot by the devils' uniform. Falco tries to stop the feet that choose. The reason he tries to stop them is that enough have already died. Gabi does not hear the talk of the town that died. The hand that does not hear searches for the gun's position.

segments.ja: フロックは、この離脱をエレンの正しさとして見ています。見ている声は、若い兵のあいだで大きいです。大きい主張は、敵の町を踏んだことが勝利だ、です。だ、を、ハンジは短く遮ります。遮る理由は、まだ船は安全圏に入っていない、です。入っていない空に、マーレの砲が追ってきます。追ってくる音のあいだで、子供たちの区画は監視が薄れます。薄れる隙が、凶弾の通路です。
segments.en: Floch is seeing this withdrawal as Eren's being right. The voice that sees it is loud among the young soldiers. The loud claim is that trampling the enemy town was a victory. Hange cuts that short. The reason she cuts it is that the ship has not yet entered a safe zone. In the sky it has not entered, Marley's cannon follows. Between the sound that follows, the watch on the children's compartment thins. The thinning gap is the path of the shot.

segments.ja: 船内の狭い通路で、ファルコはガビの銃に手をかけます。かける争いは、声を大きくできません。できない理由は、兵がすぐそこにいる、です。いる争いの結果、銃は一度床に落ちます。落ちた銃を、ガビが先に拾い直します。拾い直す目は、泣いています。泣いているのに、照準は揺るぎません。揺るがないことが、候補として育てられた反射です。反射を、ファルコは友情では止め切れません。床に落ちた銃は、二人のあいだで一度だけ転がります。
segments.en: In a narrow passage of the ship, Falco puts a hand on Gabi's gun. The struggle of putting it there cannot be loud. The reason it cannot is that soldiers are right there. As a result of the struggle that is there, the gun falls to the floor once. Gabi picks the fallen gun back up first. The eyes that pick it back up are crying. Even crying, the aim does not waver. The not wavering is a reflex raised as a candidate. Falco cannot fully stop the reflex with friendship. The gun that fell to the floor rolls once between the two of them.

segments.en: Sasha comes into the passage looking for the rest of the shared food. The timing of coming out overlaps Gabi's muzzle. She sees the overlapping opponent as a child and does not raise a blade at once. The judgment of not raising it is not the training's way of telling enemies. It is not. It is an ordinary walk, hungry. The chest of the walk enters the line of the shot. Connie is still laughing behind, at the entering. The friend who is laughing does not know the meaning of the sound.

Ahead of the echo, she has not yet finished the talk of food. The mouth that has not finished loses its words to blood.

segments.titleJa: ガビは正解だと思っている
segments.ja: ガビは、撃ったことを誤りだとはまだ思っていません。思っていない理由は、悪魔の兵を一人止めた、です。止めた相手が笑っていたことを、彼女は弱さだと考えます。考えるファルコは、隣で首を振ります。振る理由は、笑いは弱さではなかった、です。なかったことを、彼は言葉にできず、ただ銃を見ます。見る銃は、もう弾を持っていません。持っていない一発が、船の空気を変えています。正しいと思っている指は、まだ銃の形を覚えています。
segments.en: Gabi does not yet think that shooting was a mistake. The reason she does not think it is that she stopped one devil soldier. She thinks that the opponent she stopped was laughing was a weakness. Falco, thinking otherwise, shakes his head beside her. The reason he shakes it is that the laugh was not a weakness. He cannot put the was not into words, and only looks at the gun. The gun he looks at no longer has a bullet. The one shot that does not have it is changing the air of the ship. The finger that still thinks it was right remembers the shape of the gun.
